name: BOELE, Nicolette

headline.note: The official history identifies two public, one private-consultancy and several nonprofit roles, but only year-level endpoints and no substantive full-time evidence. The Good Car Company role is governance rather than proven employment. Missing evidence and unlisted years are not zero.
